items.title_zhTW: NovaRadar 葉秉陽博士受邀出席 2026 Emerging Biologics Summit Asia
items.title_en: NovaRadar's Ping-Yang Yeh, Ph.D. Speaks at the 2026 Emerging Biologics Summit Asia
items.summary_zhTW: NovaRadar Bio Venture 執行合夥人葉秉陽博士，受邀出席 Mycenax 於台北主辦之生物製劑高峰會，與國際業界專家交流 ADC 與次世代生物製劑技術。
items.summary_en: Ping-Yang (Ping) Yeh, Ph.D., Managing Partner at NovaRadar Bio Venture, joined global industry leaders at Mycenax's biologics summit in Taipei to discuss ADC and next-generation biologics.
items.content_zhTW:
Mycenax Biotech Inc. 於台北主辦「2026 Emerging Biologics Summit Asia」，匯聚全球專家與業界領袖，探討抗體藥物複合體（ADC）技術與次世代生物製劑量產的最新進展。

本屆高峰會由工研院生醫與醫材研究所 陸巧曦（Maggie Lu）博士擔任主持人，講者陣容包括 NovaRadar Bio Venture（MitoBitTech）執行合夥人葉秉陽（Ping-Yang Yeh）博士、RIN Institute Inc. 總裁 Yasuhiro Matsumura 博士，以及 GlycanLink 執行長 Yang Yang 博士。

葉博士以「The New Biopharma Playbook：以速度取勝的臨床概念驗證」為題發表演說，分享 NovaRadar 以營運操盤思維加速生技專案從科學走向臨床驗證的方法。

日期：2026 年 7 月 14 日（週二）13:00–17:00
地點：The Place Taipei（台北市南港區經貿二路 196 號）
items.content_en:
Mycenax Biotech Inc. hosted the 2026 Emerging Biologics Summit Asia in Taipei, Taiwan, bringing together global experts and industry leaders to explore the latest advances in antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) technologies and next-generation biologics manufacturing.

The summit was chaired by Maggie Lu, Ph.D., General Director of Biomedical Technology and Device Research Laboratories at ITRI, and featured distinguished speakers including Ping-Yang (Ping) Yeh, Ph.D., Managing Partner at NovaRadar Bio Venture (MitoBitTech); Yasuhiro Matsumura, Ph.D., President of RIN Institute Inc.; and Yang Yang, Ph.D., CEO of GlycanLink.

Dr. Yeh presented "The New Biopharma Playbook: Winning Through Speed to Clinical Proof-of-Concept," sharing NovaRadar's operator-led approach to accelerating biotech programs from science to clinical validation.

Date: July 14, 2026 (Tue), 13:00–17:00
Venue: The Place Taipei, No. 196, Jingmao 2nd Rd., Nangang District, Taipei City

items.title_zhTW: 葉秉陽博士於美國聖地牙哥 TCA Forum 分享臨床概念驗證加速心法
items.title_en: Ping-Yang Yeh, Ph.D. Presents on Speed to Clinical Proof-of-Concept at TCA Forum, San Diego
items.summary_zhTW: NovaRadar 執行合夥人葉秉陽博士於美國聖地牙哥 Taiwan CDMO Alliance（TCA）論壇，分享 CMC 與 CDMO 整合策略。
items.summary_en: NovaRadar Managing Partner Ping-Yang (Ping) Yeh, Ph.D. spoke on CMC-CDMO integration at the Taiwan CDMO Alliance forum in San Diego, USA.
items.content_zhTW:
NovaRadar Bio Venture 執行合夥人暨 Taiwan CDMO Alliance（TCA）執行顧問葉秉陽（Ping-Yang Yeh）博士，於美國加州聖地牙哥舉行之 TCA Forum 發表演說，題目為「Speed to Clinical Proof-of-Concept：CMC 與 CDMO 整合的力量」。

葉博士曾任職於 Amgen、Biogen Idec 與 GSK，加入 NovaRadar 前累積豐富跨國藥廠營運經驗。此次演講中，他分享如何透過緊密整合化學製造管制（CMC）與委託開發暨製造（CDMO）夥伴，大幅縮短從科學發現到臨床概念驗證的時程，此亦為 NovaRadar 營運操盤式投資理念的核心精神。

日期：2026 年 6 月 21 日
地點：TCA Forum, San Diego, CA, USA
items.content_en:
Ping-Yang (Ping) Yeh, Ph.D., Managing Partner at NovaRadar Bio Venture and Executive Advisor to the Taiwan CDMO Alliance (TCA), gave an insightful talk titled "Speed to Clinical Proof-of-Concept: The Power of CMC-CDMO Integration" at the TCA Forum in San Diego, CA, USA.

Drawing on his career spanning Amgen, Biogen Idec, and GSK before joining NovaRadar, Dr. Yeh discussed how tightly integrating chemistry, manufacturing and controls (CMC) with contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) partners can materially shorten the path from promising science to clinical proof-of-concept — a core tenet of NovaRadar's operator-led investment approach.

Date: June 21, 2026
Venue: TCA Forum, San Diego, CA, USA

items.title_zhTW: 胡瑞卿共同創辦人受邀於國家衛生研究院分享「當 AI 開始理解生命」
items.title_en: Charlene Hu Invited to Speak at NHRI: "When AI Begins to Understand Life"
items.summary_zhTW: 值國家衛生研究院（NHRI）30 週年之際，NovaRadar 共同創辦人暨執行合夥人胡瑞卿（Charlene Hu）受邀分享科技、資本與醫療交會的觀察。
items.summary_en: At NHRI's 30th-anniversary year, NovaRadar Co-founder & Managing Partner Charlene Hu was invited by Taiwan's National Health Research Institutes (NHRI) to share her perspective on technology, capital, and medicine.
items.content_zhTW:
NovaRadar Bio Venture 共同創辦人暨執行合夥人胡瑞卿（Charlene Hu）受邀參訪國家衛生研究院（NHRI），並發表演講「當 AI 開始理解生命——科技、資本與醫療的交會，以及價值如何被重新定義」。

胡瑞卿感謝主辦單位與現場研究人員、科學家及專業人士參與討論。她提到，出身科技與投資背景，過去職涯多聚焦於數據、模型、機率與決策；但踏入醫療與生命科學領域後，她持續體會到，有些最重要的問題無法只靠統計解答。她認為，從醫療產業學到最重要的一課，是「價值」並非總能被計算，有時它需要被承擔——以耐心、謙卑與責任承擔之。

此行適逢 NHRI 成立 30 週年系列活動期間，胡瑞卿並與 NHRI 相關主管合影留念、互贈紀念品。

日期：2026 年 6 月（確切日期未公開，依 LinkedIn 貼文相對時間推估）
地點：國家衛生研究院（NHRI），台灣
items.content_en:
Charlene Hu, Co-founder & Managing Partner of NovaRadar Bio Venture, was invited by Taiwan's National Health Research Institutes (NHRI) to give a talk titled "When AI Begins to Understand Life: The Intersection of Technology, Capital, and Medicine — and How Value Is Redefined."

Hu thanked the organizer and all the researchers, scientists, and professionals who joined the discussion. Coming from a background in technology and investing, she noted that much of her career had centered on data, models, probabilities, and decision-making — yet her journey into healthcare and life sciences has continually reminded her that some of the most important questions cannot be answered by statistics alone. Perhaps the most important lesson she has learned from healthcare, she said, is that value is not always something to be calculated; sometimes it is something to be carried, with patience, humility, and responsibility.

The visit took place during NHRI's 30th-anniversary year, and Hu was photographed with NHRI representatives and exchanged commemorative gifts.

Date: June 2026 (exact date not publicly disclosed; estimated from LinkedIn post timing)
Venue: National Health Research Institutes (NHRI), Taiwan
